rationale: Recent anchor and loss-path edits regressed badly, so this stays in the proven recurrent-tail family but spends the next run on a larger structural probe instead of another scalar sweep. The edit expands the reverse recurrent tail from 2 to 3 blocks while delaying the extra recurrence with a later, softer curriculum, aiming to buy more late-stage recurrent depth without paying the full optimization cost early in the 600s budget.
title: Three-Block Late Reverse-Tail Curriculum
